description_en: Queries the details of a project authorization
name: GetProjectAuthorization

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the project authorization to query.
You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的项目授权的ID。
您可以调用ListProjectAuthorizations接口获取该参数
parameters.name: authorization_id

ProjectAuthorization.description_en: The details of the project authorization

Description.description_en: The description of the project authorization

Principals.description_en: The information about the project administrators specified in the project authorization
Principals.description_zh: 项目授权中指定的项目管理员信息

PrincipalId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user specified as the project administrator when PrincipalType is RamUser. The ARN of the RAM role specified as the project administrator when PrincipalType is RamRole
PrincipalId.description_zh: 当 PrincipalType 返回值为 RamUser 时，表示指定为的项目管理员的 RAM 用户 ID。当 PrincipalType 返回值为 RamRole 时，表示指定为的项目管理员的 RAM 角色 ARN

PrincipalName.description_en: The display name of the RAM user or RAM role of the project administrator
PrincipalName.description_zh: 项目管理员的 RAM 用户/RAM 角色显示名称

PrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the project administrator. Valid values:

RamUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

RamRole: RAM role
PrincipalType.description_zh:
项目管理员类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。

RamRole：RAM角色

ProjectIds.description_en: The list of project IDs associated with the project authorization
ProjectIds.description_zh: 项目授权中关联的项目ID列表

Projects.description_en: The information about the projects associated with the project authorization
Projects.description_zh: 项目授权中关联的项目信息

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the project is the default project. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为Default项目，取值：

true：是。
false：不是

ScopeType.description_en:
The scope of manageable assets associated with the authorization. Valid values:

1: All projects.

2: Specified projects
ScopeType.description_zh:
授权关联可管理的资产范围。取值：

1：所有项目。

2：指定项目

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
